title: Xometry, Inc. 2025 Form 10-K
excerpt: Revenue rose from USD 463.4 million in 2023 to USD 686.6 million in 2025 while operating loss narrowed from USD 73.6 million to USD 45.5 million.
summary: The audited filing establishes Xometry's three-year revenue, gross-profit, operating-loss, operating-cash-flow and stock-compensation history. Revenue and gross profit expanded and operating cash flow turned positive in 2025, but GAAP operating and net losses persisted and stock compensation increased.
